params.description: Unique identifier representing a Workspace.

params.name: elementId
params.description: Unique identifier representing a specific element.

params.name: statistics
params.description:
Comma-separated list of statistics to get. Available statistics are: AVG_DURATION (ms), MIN_DURATION (ms), MAX_DURATION (ms), COUNT, THROUGHPUT (Byte/s), ELEMENTS_PER_SECOND, ERRORS, ERRORS_PER_SECOND, ERROR_RATE (%), AVG_TTFB (ms), MIN_TTFB (ms), MAX_TTFB (ms).
Example: AVG_DURATION,ELEMENTS_PER_SECOND

items.docs: Provides all the points of a Test Result element for the selected statistics.
